title: Families below the built-up rock, Nui Ba Den
description: Below a huge boulder capped with a mortared-stone footing and a plank structure, a young woman in a lilac patterned blouse laughs with a baby on her hip; another woman at left holds a toddler in a striped shirt, a boy's head shows at bottom centre, and a young man in camouflage looks into the lens at lower right. Guy wires cross the frame. "The guy in the lower right was a really nice guy. He had like 6 or 7 kids, could speak some english."
researchNotes: Larry's comment of 2026-09-12 (giscus-vn-0038-c18416119.json). The man is not named, and Larry did not say whether the women and children here are his family. The structure on the rock is not identified.
